collection.compiler_build: Common source/build paths and verified stage0/LLVM/optimized developer recipe for baseline and candidates. Keep exact compiler driver identities and all shared runtime file checks. Verify focused correctness tests.
collection.contexts: Compare executed argv and ordered environments using only verified compiler-specific namespace substitutions and the stale jobserver exclusion. Retain the actual SDK12 unit counts and output classes.
collection.cpus: Controller CPU8 and measured process CPUs0–7 with eight compiler threads. Separate all heavy builders from the measurement window.
collection.edit: Use the known equal-length comment fixture. Before every sample, warm on BEFORE with native Cargo and capture the exact ordinary library compiler invocation. Measure once on AFTER and restore original source/mode. Restore/converge each arm at block end.
collection.state: Fresh per-arm Cargo target/shared/package state at common physical paths. Reuse immutable locked dependency archives. Verify native invocation and freshness for the actual SDK12 command.
collection.validity: Require exit success, expected source/target/output kinds, complete raw final Ir matching self-cost sum and stderr, input/output context integrity, restoration and parked state. Record host observations without filtering count results. Preserve technical failures and correct the cause before fresh collection.

encoder.endpoint: ordinary uv library rustc invocation captured from cargo -Zohm-defaults=yes test --no-run --locked --offline -j8
encoder.purpose: Check applicability of SDK6 PR216 on the current SDK12 stack.

green_lookup.endpoint: ordinary uv library rustc invocation captured from cargo -Zohm-defaults=yes check --locked --offline -j8
green_lookup.purpose: Measure the spill-free lookup during incremental check. Run only if the actual SDK12 compiler has the duplicate baseline comparison and the candidate removes it without a hot-value store.

design.method: Paired geometric baseline/candidate ratios with the existing paired_count_statistics reader. Report reduction as 1 minus reciprocal ratio. Exact two-sided sign p reported per block.
design.metric: whole isolated ordinary rustc final Callgrind Ir, inclusive of its own worker threads and procedural macros
design.statistical_scope: Nominal per-block intervals and sign tests. Pair scheduling and exchangeability assumptions apply. Each endpoint has its own claim.
design.stopping: Stop on the first valid block failing either gate. No extra pairs, retries of valid failures, or pooling with SDK6. Report per-block results and order effects.

publication: A new current-stack performance claim requires both fresh blocks and complete correctness checks. A valid failure is reported. Native whole-command time is separate and receives a claim only from its own prospectively fixed validation.
scope: Two separate prospective comparisons on the published SDK12 source and fixed released Cargo. Freeze before any SDK12 candidate measurement. Each candidate has one primary endpoint.
